votes.motion: A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Alison Stroud, to approve the Consent Calendar

A motion was made by Cyndi Sharkey, seconded by Zach Robinson, to adopt Ordinance 22-01, an ordinance of Sandy City amending City Code Chapter 19-4 to include section 19-4-11: Sandy City Bulk Waste Clean-up Regulations amending section E. a. iv. to change the diameter from 12 inches to 18 inches, amending section E. a. v. to increase the maximum weight from 20 to 50 pounds, and amending section E. a. vi. To remove the limitation on diameter
